name: Mantle
long_description:
Mantle is a full-stack field service company that deploys, fixes and maintains machines for the companies that build them. We're not a marketplace or software tool, we own uptime directly to provide better, more reliable service without burdening your engineers on support calls. 

$500B+ a year is spent to keep machines running in the US, we're coming for all of it.
one_liner: The pit crew for machines and robots.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Co-Founder & CEO at Mantle, the pit crew for deployed machines and robots.

Previously founded Curo (YC F24), the world's largest private EV charging network. Curo scaled to 5,000 stations with Uber, Zoox and Google across 15 states before acquisition by Inspiration Mobility Group ($415M raised).

Before Curo I joined Tesla at 18 as the youngest employee.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
Co-Founder & CTO at Mantle, the pit crew for deployed machines and robots.

Previously founded Babylon, the world’s largest fleet of autonomous vertical farms. Babylon raised $22M and deployed 400 farms with Compass, LinkedIn and American Airlines.

Before Babylon I scaled an electronics repair business I started at 14.
